operations.name: Export Applications
operations.description:
Export the list of applications installed on endpoints with Application Risk-enabled Agents and their properties, including the CVEs for each application that requires a patch. The CSV file is stored on the Management. Application Risk requires Complete SKU.
This feature is in EA. To join the EA program, contact your SentinelOne Sales Rep.

query.name: accountIds
query.description: List of Account IDs to filter by. Example: "225494730938493804,225494730938493915".

query.name: agentComputerName__contains
query.description: Free-text filter by computer name (supports multiple values). Example: "john-office,WIN".

query.name: agentIsDecommissioned
query.description: Include active agents, decommissioned or both. Example: "True,False".

query.name: agentMachineTypes
query.description: Filter by endpoint machine types. Example: "unknown".

query.name: agentMachineTypesNin
query.description: Filter not by endpoint machine types. Example: "unknown".

query.name: agentOsVersion__contains
query.description: Free-text filter by OS full name and version (supports multiple values). Example: "Service Pack 1".

query.name: agentUuid__contains
query.description: Free-text filter by agent UUID (supports multiple values). Example: "e92-01928,b055".

query.name: groupIds
query.description: List of Group IDs to filter by. Example: "225494730938493804,225494730938493915".

query.name: ids
query.description: Filter by application IDs. Example: "225494730938493804,225494730938493915".

query.name: installedAt__between
query.description: Filter by installation date range

query.name: name__contains
query.description: Free-text filter by application name (supports multiple values). Example: "calc".

query.name: osTypes
query.description: Filter by OS types. Example: "windows_legacy".

query.name: osTypesNin
query.description: Filter not by OS types. Example: "windows_legacy".

query.name: publisher__contains
query.description: Free-text filter by application publisher (supports multiple values). Example: "Sentinel".

query.name: riskLevels
query.description: Filter by risk. Example: "none".

query.name: riskLevelsNin
query.description: Filter not by risk. Example: "none".

query.name: siteIds
query.description: List of Site IDs to filter by. Example: "225494730938493804,225494730938493915".

query.name: size__between
query.description: Filter by application size range (bytes). Example: "1024-104856".

query.name: types
query.description: Filter by application types. Example: "app".

query.name: typesNin
query.description: Filter not by application types. Example: "app".

query.name: version__contains
query.description: Free-text filter by application version (supports multiple values). Example: "1.22.333,build".
